title: Robin Sloan - Writing with the machine: GPT-2 and text generation
speaker: Robin Sloan
talk_title: Writing with the machine: GPT-2 and text generation
description:
This talk is from the 2019 Roguelike Celebration - find out more at https://roguelike.club/event2019.html

Robin Sloan is the author of the novels Mr. Penumbra's 24-Hour Bookstore and Sourdough. He also regularly publishes digital experiments.
